reviews.name: SmartRecruiters
reviews.note: Parent (SAP) and languages (en, de, fr) found. About page gives no founding year, only 'founded on a bold belief'. Pricing page states no pricing model, only 'Talk to an expert' and 'Build your RFP' style contact paths. The partnerships page had no ownership statement.

reviews.name: Teamtailor
reviews.note: Language menu shows English (US) only. Pricing is by quote with no public price. About page and homepage give no founding year. 'First partnership was formed in late 2013' is not a founding date.

reviews.name: iCIMS
reviews.note: Parent is Vista Equity Partners (investor since August 2018). Language selector links UK (en-gb) and France (fr). No founding year on company, leadership, newsroom or homepage pages.

reviews.name: The Adecco Group
reviews.note: adecco.com homepage has no HQ or history. The group site adeccogroup.com (a different domain from the entry URL) was read on the homepage, our-group, about-us and investors pages, with no HQ or founding statement. The press release dateline 'Zurich, Switzerland' is not a headquarters statement. The investors factsheet PDF returned HTTP 503.

reviews.name: Wellfound
reviews.note: About page timeline has '2019' against AngelList splitting into two businesses, not Wellfound's founding. It says AngelList Talent 'started' without a year. Wellfound 'spun out as an independent company (AL Talent, Inc.)' with no named parent.

reviews.name: BambooHR
reviews.note: Founding year 2008 quoted from the About BambooHR page via the fetch tool; the headless reader text did not contain the story body, so the quote is taken from the fetch tool output. Pricing page shows Try it free and Get a Free Price Quote, no list prices.

reviews.name: Zhaopin
reviews.note: Headless reader returned a Tencent EdgeOne security verification page and was not used further. Fetch of the homepage read the full page in two parts (offsets 0 and 100000). Footer shows an About Us heading and a company introduction link, plus the operating company name, but the link URL could not be located and /about/ returned 404. No founding year or owner stated on pages read.

reviews.name: Toptal
reviews.note: Founding year 2010 from the Press Center page via the fetch tool. The headless reader was blocked by a Cloudflare 403 on both press-center and about, so the fact comes from the fetch tool output only.
